sources.title: Label Encoding in Python - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Label Encoding is a data preprocessing technique used to convert categorical values into numerical labels. It assigns a unique integer to each category, allowing machine learning algorithms to process categorical data in a numerical format.
